traits.name: Rampage.
traits.text: If the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
